Placecol Skin Care Clinic Cycad is a skin and beauty clinic in Shop 16A at Cycad Centre, on Outspan Drive in Bendor Park, Polokwane. Its service menu covers facials and skincare, including acne facials, chemical peels, dermaplaning, facial extractions and microdermabrasion. Body treatments include cellulite and body sculpting, and the clinic also offers threading, hair removal, makeup and massage.

Clients can book through the clinic's online listing or by calling the clinic, and the published menu makes it easy to compare treatments before a visit. The clinic suits people who want targeted skin treatments as well as relaxing massage in one place, close to the shops and services at Cycad Centre.

PostNet Paledi Mall is a branch of the national PostNet retail network, trading from Shop 78 inside Paledi Mall on the R71 in Ga Thoka, Mankweng. The branch offers courier and mailing services, printing and copying, stationery supplies and other digital services for people and businesses in the area.

It serves shoppers and small businesses across Mankweng and the surrounding Turfloop area who need a courier drop-off point, document printing, photocopying or everyday stationery without travelling into central Polokwane. Trading from inside Paledi Mall means the store sits alongside the centre's other shops, making it a convenient stop to combine with a regular shopping trip for postal, courier and printing errands.

Rabie Panel Beaters is a panelbeating, auto-body repair and spray-painting workshop based at 12 Mangaan Street in Nirvana, Polokwane. Current business listings describe the workshop restoring vehicles after collision damage, covering both the structural repair work and the cosmetic finish needed to bring a vehicle's panels and paintwork back to shape.

The workshop serves vehicle owners who need their car's bodywork and appearance restored after an accident, from minor dents and scuffs through to more serious panel damage. Based in Nirvana, it is a practical option for motorists across Polokwane needing panelbeating, spray-painting and general body restoration carried out in one workshop.

As a Post Office branch, it handles the standard counter services of the national network, including mail and parcel postage, collection and related postal products, for residents and businesses in the surrounding area.

It serves people and organisations across Seshego who need a nearby postal counter rather than travelling into central Polokwane for the same services. Trading from inside Seshego Plaza, the branch sits alongside the centre's other shops, making it a convenient stop for anyone combining postal business with a shopping trip to the plaza.

The store operates as a full-service supermarket with a bakery, a deli counter and a grocery-delivery service alongside its everyday range of groceries and household essentials.

It serves households and shoppers in Mankweng and the surrounding area who rely on the branch for a weekly grocery shop or smaller top-up purchases close to home. Trading from inside Paledi Mall on the R71, the store sits alongside the centre's other shops, making it a convenient stop for everyday shopping in the area.

items.description:
Tops at Spar Platinum Park is a liquor store trading alongside SUPERSPAR Platinum Park, at the Outspan Drive and General Maritz Street complex in Bendor Park, Polokwane. As part of the Tops at Spar chain, the store stocks beer, wine, spirits and soft drinks for customers shopping at the centre.

It serves adults in Bendor Park and the surrounding area who are buying alcoholic drinks and related beverages, whether for a one-off occasion or as part of a regular grocery run. Trading next to the SUPERSPAR at Platinum Park, the store is a convenient stop for shoppers picking up drinks alongside their everyday shopping in the centre.

Totalsports Savannah Mall is a branch of the national Totalsports chain, trading from Shop 45 inside Savannah Mall at the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park. The store stocks sportswear, footwear and sporting equipment for customers shopping at the mall.

It serves customers across Fauna Park and the wider Polokwane area who are looking for sports clothing, footwear and equipment for everyday training, running or general sport and fitness. Trading from inside Savannah Mall, the store sits alongside the mall's other shops, making it an easy stop for shoppers combining sportswear shopping with a visit to the centre.

Totalsports in Seshego is a branch of the national Totalsports chain, trading from Shop 2B on Ditlou Street in Seshego-B. The store carries sportswear, footwear and sporting equipment from major brands such as Nike, adidas, Under Armour and Puma, stocked as part of the same range sold across Totalsports branches nationally.

It serves sports and fitness customers in Seshego who want to shop locally for training gear, running shoes and everyday sportswear rather than travelling into central Polokwane for the same selection. The branch forms part of the Totalsports chain within the TFG group's sports division, giving local shoppers access to the same national ranges and promotions as larger stores elsewhere. Trading on Ditlou Street in Seshego, the branch is a convenient option for residents picking up sportswear close to home.

Uys PG Attorney is a law firm practising from offices at 33 General Joubert Street in Polokwane Central. The firm operates as an attorney practice serving the Polokwane area, offering legal representation and advice to clients who need the services of a qualified attorney for matters that require formal legal standing.

It serves individuals and organisations across Polokwane who need an attorney to represent them in a dispute, draft or review legal documents, or give general legal advice on a matter affecting them personally or in business. Based in Polokwane Central, the practice is placed centrally for clients who want to consult an attorney without travelling far from the CBD, making it a practical choice for people already in the city centre for other business, alongside the area's other law firms.

Wolkberg Veterinary Clinic is a small-animal veterinary practice at 101 Jorissen Street in Sterpark, Polokwane. The clinic treats dogs, cats and other small animals alongside reptiles and birds, and it keeps a stock of anti-venom for treating the bites of common local snake species.

It serves pet and animal owners across Sterpark and the wider Polokwane area who need veterinary care beyond the usual cat-and-dog consultation, including reptile keepers and bird owners. The clinic's anti-venom stock makes it a useful option for anyone whose pet has been bitten by a snake, a situation that needs prompt treatment rather than a routine appointment.

Checkers Polokwane is a full-service supermarket trading at the corner of Grobler Street and Hans van Rensburg Street in Polokwane Central. The store is set up with a bakery, a butchery, a deli counter and a fruit-and-vegetable section alongside its general grocery and household range, giving shoppers the full spread of a Checkers supermarket within the city centre.

It serves local households and shoppers across Polokwane Central who do their everyday grocery shopping in the CBD, from a full weekly shop to smaller top-up purchases picked up during a lunch break or after work. Trading inside Checkers Centre in the heart of Polokwane, the store is a practical stop for shoppers already in the CBD for work, errands or other shopping, without needing to travel out to a mall on the edge of town.

Clicks Grobler Street is a pharmacy and health, beauty and wellness store trading inside Netcare Pholoso Hospital on Grobler Street in Fauna Park. As part of the national Clicks chain, the branch stocks prescription medicines, vitamins and supplements, and everyday health, beauty and personal-care products.

Its location inside the hospital makes it a natural stop for patients and hospital visitors who need to collect a prescription or pick up healthcare essentials while they are already on site. It also serves shoppers from the wider Fauna Park area looking for Clicks' usual range of pharmacy, healthcare and personal-care products in one place.

Clicks Polokwane Shoprite Checkers is a pharmacy and health, beauty and wellness store trading on Hans van Rensburg Street in Polokwane Central, inside the Checkers Centre. Besides its retail pharmacy, the branch is also listed as a medical clinic, combining a dispensary with consultation services alongside its usual Clicks product range of vitamins, supplements and personal care.

Local shoppers and patients across Polokwane Central use the branch both for everyday pharmacy and healthcare purchases and for the clinic services on offer, making it a convenient single stop inside the Checkers Centre. Trading alongside Checkers and the centre's other shops, it suits anyone combining a pharmacy visit with other shopping in the CBD.

Clicks Seshego Circle trades on Ditlou Street inside Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, serving as the local branch of the national Clicks pharmacy and health, beauty and personal-care chain. The store stocks prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and supplements alongside its usual range of beauty and household essentials.

Residents and shoppers in Seshego use the branch for everyday pharmacy needs and personal-care shopping without having to travel into central Polokwane. Trading inside Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, the store sits alongside the centre's other shops, making it an easy stop for anyone combining a pharmacy visit with a regular shopping trip to the centre.

Dr. M.B. Seopa Dental and Medical Aesthetics is a dental and medical aesthetics practice at the Redimed Building, 41A Grobler Street in Polokwane Central. The practice is listed as both a dental clinic and a medical spa, combining general and cosmetic dental care with medical aesthetic treatments under one roof.

It serves patients across Polokwane Central who are looking for dental treatment as well as those seeking non-surgical aesthetic procedures, allowing both kinds of appointments to be arranged at the same practice. Based in the Redimed Building on Grobler Street, the practice is centrally located for patients visiting the CBD for dental or aesthetic care.

Duka Driving Academy is a driving school operating from 98 Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central. The academy provides practical driving instruction for learner and licensed drivers who want to build or improve their driving skills under professional guidance, covering the fundamentals of vehicle control and safe driving on the road.

It serves learner drivers across Polokwane who are working towards a driver's licence, as well as existing drivers who want further instruction behind the wheel to sharpen their skills or regain confidence after time away from driving. Based on Schoeman Street in the city centre, the academy is a convenient option for students arranging lessons around work, school or other commitments, without having to travel outside Polokwane Central for instruction.

Dynotech Auto Service Centre is an automotive workshop at 7 Mangaan Street in Nirvana Extension 1, Polokwane. The centre carries out mechanical servicing and repairs for vehicle owners, covering the kind of routine and general mechanical work a car needs to keep running properly, from scheduled services to fixing mechanical faults as they come up.

It serves vehicle owners across Nirvana and the wider Polokwane area who need a local workshop for servicing and mechanical repairs rather than relying solely on a dealership or travelling across town for routine maintenance. Based in Nirvana Extension 1, the centre is a practical option for motorists wanting maintenance and repair work done close to home, forming part of the established automotive trade along Mangaan Street.

Fena Bearings CC is a bearing supplier trading from Shop 20C, 20 Witklip Street in Ladanna, Polokwane. The business supplies bearings to customers across the area, serving the kind of day-to-day replacement and spare-parts needs that come with keeping vehicles, machinery and industrial equipment in good working order.

It serves automotive, industrial and mechanical customers across Polokwane who need bearings for vehicles, equipment or machinery, whether for a one-off repair or ongoing maintenance work at a workshop or factory. Trading from Witklip Street in Ladanna, an area known locally for its motor and industrial trade, the business is a practical supplier for workshops, technicians and other customers in the area's automotive and industrial sector.

Customers who shop there regularly point to its meat counter as the main draw, singling out its biltong and local cheeses, including Klippiesveld cheese, alongside its everyday grocery range. Reviewers describe the staff as friendly and the shop as a convenient, well-located stop for everyday shopping in the area.

Freshwell suits Bendor Park households and shoppers from the surrounding suburbs who want quality meat and a quick grocery run without a trip into central Polokwane. It trades daily from Bendor Shopping Centre, making it a practical neighbourhood option for regular shopping as well as for picking up something specific, like biltong or a particular cheese, on the way home.

LEDA Platinum Office is a Ladanna branch of the Limpopo Economic Development Agency, the provincial body responsible for driving economic growth and building sustainable communities across Limpopo. The agency works through investment promotion, enterprise development, industrialisation and job creation, running programmes that support local businesses and connect investors to opportunities in the province. It also publishes its own tender and procurement notices and lists job opportunities for people wanting to work in economic development.

The agency has highlighted a Limpopo Investment Conference as part of its work to showcase investment opportunities in the province, and keeps its programme and services information available to businesses, entrepreneurs and cooperatives who approach it for support. This office in Ladanna, Polokwane, gives local SMMEs, cooperatives and would-be investors in the area a point of contact with the agency's province-wide investment and enterprise-development work.

Mankweng Midas is the Paledi Mall branch of the Midas automotive parts and accessories chain, trading from Shop 39 on the R71 in Mankweng. The chain stocks spares, tools, batteries and vehicle accessories for cars and motorcycles, giving motorists in the area a local source for parts and everyday vehicle maintenance needs.

The branch keeps extended weekday trading hours, opening from Monday to Saturday and for a shorter session on Sunday mornings, which suits motorists needing parts outside of a standard working week. Based in Paledi Mall in Mankweng, Polokwane, it serves vehicle owners, motorists and tradespeople from Mankweng and the surrounding Turfloop area looking for parts, batteries and accessories close to home.

items.description:
Sheet Street Limpopo Mall is a homeware and decor store trading inside Limpopo Mall, on the corner of Rissik, Market and Devenish Streets in Polokwane Central. It is one of several Polokwane branches of the national Sheet Street chain, which sells homeware, soft furnishings and decor pieces aimed at furnishing a home on a budget.

The branch keeps weekday trading hours into the early evening, with shorter hours on Saturdays and a shorter Sunday morning session, giving shoppers several days a week to browse. Based in the Polokwane CBD at Limpopo Mall, it suits shoppers in and around the city centre looking to update or furnish a home without travelling to one of the city's other malls.

Polokwane Tractors (Pty) Ltd is an agricultural machinery dealer at 33 Corundum Street in Futura, Polokwane. The business specialises in Massey Ferguson and Challenger tractors and equipment for the local farming sector. It has a showroom where buyers can view machinery in person, and a service and repairs side that supports customers who already own equipment.

The company says it has in-depth knowledge of the agriculture sector and recommends the correct machinery and equipment for each customer's requirements. Its stated aim is to be the preferred brand in the sector through quality service, and to run a sustainable, profitable business that creates skilled jobs in the surrounding area. Farmers and agricultural businesses in the Polokwane area can get in touch through the website's contact page.

Sans Souci Towing Services is a light, medium and heavy-duty towing and recovery operator based at 34 Chroom Street in Futura, Polokwane. The company covers breakdowns as well as complex vehicle recoveries, and it offers specialised transport, load assistance and goods-in-transit services. Its fleet is described as powerful enough for demanding recovery jobs.

The company lists emergency assistance and branches on its website, along with a company profile and health and safety policy. Its stated mission is to provide reliable, efficient and safe towing and recovery services. The business serves Polokwane and routes across Limpopo, Gauteng and Mpumalanga, which makes it useful for drivers and fleet operators who need recovery outside the city.

Sheet Street Seshego Circle is a homeware and décor store in Shop 11 at Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, on the corner of Nelson Mandela Drive and Polokwane Drive in Seshego. It sells bedroom and living room décor, soft furnishings and clothing alongside its homeware. The branch is part of the national Sheet Street chain, which says it has been helping customers create homes they love for 31 years.

The range includes new-in homeware and seasonal collections, and the chain describes its aim as offering tasteful products at good value on a budget. The store page also lists a wishlist and an account option for customers who want to plan purchases before visiting. The shop suits shoppers in Seshego looking for affordable homeware close to home.

Corrie Nel & Kie Attorneys is a law firm at Ismini Office Park in Bendor, Polokwane, specialising in property law and conveyancing, commercial and corporate law, personal estate planning and litigation. The firm describes itself as a small, dedicated team working in close relationship with its clients. Its aim is to find the most practical legal solution for each problem while offering professional services that give value for money.

When a matter requires it, the firm draws on an extended network of associates and experts. It also offers a risk management and compliance programme for businesses that want help managing risk and keeping their documents in order. Clients can reach the office at Adj Mauritz Dommisie Street or through the contact page on the firm's website.

Shell Millenium Motors is a Shell fuel station at 10 Thabo Mbeki Street in Polokwane Central, with a Debonairs Pizza Express outlet on site. The station sells Shell V-Power 95, Shell V-Power Diesel (50ppm), Shell Unleaded 93 and Shell Diesel Extra. Drivers can pay by credit card, including Mastercard and Visa, and the forecourt has an ATM.

The station has a bakery shop, burgers and a cafeteria, along with a shop and a toilet for customers. Its location in the CBD makes it a practical refuelling stop for drivers in the city centre, and the pizza outlet on site gives customers a second option for a quick meal.
